name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
purpose: Provide income support to small and marginal farmer families across India for purchasing agricultural inputs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly to bank account in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000.

eligibility.summary: Small and marginal landholding farmer families holding cultivable land in their names.

documents.name: Land Holding Documents
documents.why: Proves ownership of cultivable agricultural land

documents.name: Mobile Number
documents.why: For OTP verification & SMS payment alerts

applicationSteps.title: Check Eligibility
applicationSteps.desc: Ensure cultivable land is registered in your name.

applicationSteps.title: Gather Aadhaar & Passbook
applicationSteps.desc: Keep original Aadhaar card and bank passbook handy.

applicationSteps.title: Visit Jan Seva Kendra / Portal
applicationSteps.desc: Visit nearest Common Service Center (CSC) or pmkisan.gov.in.

applicationSteps.title: Submit e-KYC & Passbook
applicationSteps.desc: Complete biometric or OTP e-KYC verification.

applicationSteps.title: Receive ₹2,000 DBT
applicationSteps.desc: First installment transferred directly to your bank account.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan (Micro-Pension)
purpose: Old age protection and social security for unorganized workers like tea vendors, street hawkers, and rickshaw pullers.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000 after reaching 60 years of age, with 50% government co-contribution.

eligibility.summary: Unorganized workers aged 18 to 40 years with monthly income up to ₹15,000.

applicationSteps.title: Check Age (18-40 Years)
applicationSteps.desc: Ensure you enter before turning 40 to lock low monthly savings.

applicationSteps.title: Take Aadhaar & Jan Dhan Passbook
applicationSteps.desc: Visit nearest CSC / Jan Seva Kendra.

applicationSteps.title: Set Auto-Debit (₹55 - ₹200)
applicationSteps.desc: Select monthly savings amount matched 100% by Government.

applicationSteps.title: Receive Pension Card
applicationSteps.desc: Get Shram Yogi Pension Card for lifetime monthly ₹3,000.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Health Shield)
purpose: Provide health cover up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary cashless hospitalization.
benefits: ₹500,000 cashless hospitalization per family per year across 28,000+ empanelled hospitals.

eligibility.summary: Low-income urban & rural families identified via SECC database.

applicationSteps.title: Check Ayushman Card Status
applicationSteps.desc: Visit beneficiary.nha.gov.in or nearest hospital Arogyamitra.

applicationSteps.title: Show Aadhaar & Ration Card
applicationSteps.desc: Complete instant e-KYC.

applicationSteps.title: Get Golden Ayushman Card
applicationSteps.desc: Free Ayushman PVC Card issued.

applicationSteps.title: Cashless Treatment
applicationSteps.desc: Show card at hospital counter for ₹5 Lakh zero-cash treatment.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
dept: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
purpose: Provide up to 300 units of free electricity per month to 1 Crore households by assisting with rooftop solar panel installations.
benefits: Direct financial subsidy up to ₹78,000 for 3kW rooftop solar installation + 300 units free electricity per month.

eligibility.summary: Indian citizen families owning a suitable roof structure and valid electricity connection.

documents.name: Electricity Bill
documents.why: Verification of active electricity connection & consumer number

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.why: Identity proof for subsidy bank transfer

applicationSteps.title: Register on Portal
applicationSteps.desc: Visit pmsuryaghar.gov.in and enter your Electricity Consumer Number.

applicationSteps.title: Select Empanelled Vendor
applicationSteps.desc: Choose an official solar installer for technical survey.

applicationSteps.title: Get DISCOM Approval
applicationSteps.desc: Local power company inspects net-meter feasibility.

applicationSteps.title: Receive ₹78,000 Subsidy
applicationSteps.desc: Subsidy credited directly to your bank account within 30 days.

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Micro-Credit)
dept: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
purpose: Provide affordable collateral-free working capital micro-loans to urban & rural street vendors to restart businesses.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan starting at ₹10,000 up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and cashback incentives.

eligibility.summary: Street vendors, hawkers, cobblers, and artisans vending in urban or peri-urban areas.

documents.name: Vending Certificate / Identity Card
documents.why: Issued by Urban Local Body (ULB) / Municipal Corp

applicationSteps.title: Check Vending Certificate
applicationSteps.desc: Ensure your name is listed with Urban Local Body (ULB).

applicationSteps.title: Visit Portal / Bank Counter
applicationSteps.desc: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or local bank branch.

applicationSteps.title: Submit Aadhaar & Vending Card
applicationSteps.desc: Complete e-KYC digital application.

applicationSteps.title: Receive ₹10,000 Collateral-Free Loan
applicationSteps.desc: Loan credited directly to bank account.

name: PM MUDRA Yojana (Micro-Units Development)
purpose: Provide collateral-free business loans up to ₹10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
benefits: Loans categorized as Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (up to ₹5 Lakhs), and Tarun (up to ₹10 Lakhs) at low interest rates.

eligibility.summary: Small business owners, shopkeepers, artisans, fruit vendors, and small manufacturing units.

applicationSteps.title: Choose Loan Category (Shishu/Kishor/Tarun)
applicationSteps.desc: Select required capital amount up to ₹10 Lakhs.

applicationSteps.title: Fill MUDRA Application
applicationSteps.desc: Fill online form on udyamimitra.in or visit commercial bank.

applicationSteps.title: Submit Aadhaar & Business Plan
applicationSteps.desc: Bank verifies business location and credit score.

applicationSteps.title: Loan Disbursement & MUDRA Card
applicationSteps.desc: Get loan amount and debit MUDRA card for working capital.

name: PM Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (Girl Child Security)
dept: Ministry of Women and Child Development
purpose: Small deposit savings scheme for girl child education and marriage expenses with high government interest rates.
benefits: High compound interest (8.2%+ per annum), 100% tax exemption under 80C, and maturity payout for higher education.

eligibility.summary: Parents or legal guardians of girl child below 10 years of age (max 2 girls per family).

applicationSteps.title: Visit Post Office or Authorized Bank
applicationSteps.desc: Go to nearest India Post branch or bank.

applicationSteps.title: Submit Birth Certificate & Aadhaar
applicationSteps.desc: Fill Sukanya Samriddhi account opening form.

applicationSteps.title: Deposit Minimum ₹250
applicationSteps.desc: Pay initial deposit amount.

applicationSteps.title: Receive SSY Passbook
applicationSteps.desc: Get passbook tracking annual interest & maturity balance.

name: National Scholarship Portal (Post-Matric & Higher Ed)
purpose: Provide financial assistance and tuition fee waivers to meritorious and low-income SC, ST, OBC, and minority students.
benefits: Full tuition fee reimbursement + monthly maintenance allowance credited directly to student bank accounts.

eligibility.summary: Students enrolled in Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Graduation, or Post-Graduation with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakhs.

applicationSteps.title: Register on NSP Portal
applicationSteps.desc: Visit scholarships.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR).

applicationSteps.title: Select Scheme & Fill Form
applicationSteps.desc: Choose Post-Matric or Merit-cum-Means scholarship scheme.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Marksheet & Income Proof
applicationSteps.desc: Upload scanned certificates for institutional verification.

applicationSteps.title: Receive Scholarship DBT
applicationSteps.desc: Funds transferred directly to student bank account upon verification.

name: Fisheries
dept: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Government of India
purpose: Provide targeted social welfare and financial support under fisheries.
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) and subsidy assistance for eligible citizens.

eligibility.summary: Eligible Indian citizens meeting income and residency criteria specified under fisheries guidelines.

applicationSteps.title: Check Official Eligibility
applicationSteps.desc: Verify rules on India.gov.in for fisheries.

applicationSteps.title: Gather Documents
applicationSteps.desc: Keep Aadhaar card, passbook, and photo ready.

applicationSteps.title: Apply Online / CSC
applicationSteps.desc: Submit form at nearest Jan Seva Kendra or official portal.

en.speaker: Ramesh
en.dialogue: My fishing net is damaged and boat repairs are so costly! How will I support my family this season?
en.caption: By the riverbank, Ramesh worries about rising equipment costs and unstable income.
en.sourceRef: Fisheries Scheme Overview - Financial Support Need

en.speaker: GovToon Hero
en.dialogue: Don't worry! Under the Fisheries initiative by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, eligible citizens get direct subsidy assistance and Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) support!
en.caption: GovToon Hero introduces targeted social welfare for the fisheries sector.

en.speaker: CSC Bhaiya
en.dialogue: Applying is very simple! Just bring your Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook with IFSC, and Ration Card or Residence Proof to the nearest CSC center.
en.caption: CSC Bhaiya guides Ramesh through the required documentation process.

en.speaker: Ramesh
en.dialogue: The subsidy and DBT funds arrived directly in my bank account! Now I can repair my boat and buy new equipment with confidence!
en.caption: Ramesh happily returns to fishing with secured financial support from the government.
